_comment: Copy to ~/.local/share/quickshell/private.json and chmod 600. Deep-merged over config/dashboard.json; never commit the real file.

tasks._or: "passwordCommand": "secret-tool lookup service caldav" instead of password

kraken._comment: API key with only the 'Query Funds' permission; coins -> holdings, fiat -> cash
kraken._or: "apiSecretCommand": "secret-tool lookup service kraken" instead of apiSecret

actual.budget: budget name (only needed with several budgets)
actual.encryptionPassword: only if end-to-end encryption is on

translate.email: optional - raises the MyMemory daily quota
